lines.text: Israel camped at Ebenezer and the Philistines at Aphek, and the Philistines struck down about four thousand Israelites.
The elders had the ark of the covenant brought from Shiloh, and Eli's sons Hophni and Phinehas were with it.
Israel's shout shook the ground, and the afraid Philistines said the gods had struck the Amorites with plagues.
Israel was defeated, thirty thousand foot soldiers fell, the ark was captured, and Hophni and Phinehas died.
A Benjamite brought news to Shiloh, and Eli fell from his chair and died after judging Israel seventy years.
